about_the_game:
This DLC is not compatible with accounts created outside of Steam.

The Douglas A-26B Invader is a real jack of all trades. Its 16 bombs can pound any target to dust on the ground, while its six nose-mounted machine guns and four more in the rear turret will tear apart anyone in the sky.

DLC Content:
  • Douglas A-26B Invader, an American Tier VI Premium bomber.
  • Hangar slot for your new warbird.
  • Fully trained crew with 6 free skill points to boost your battle efficiency.
  • Unique decoration set (paint scheme and emblem) that provides additional advantages in battles.
  • Ultimate Strengthened Hardpoints (Period II).
  • Ultimate Turret Gunsight (Period II).
  • Ultimate Engine Armor Protection (Period II).
